meta.description: A social and dating app for Android that brings people together by city: build a profile, join your city's group chat, make friends, and sign in with Facebook or Google, with a web admin panel behind it.

intro.name: Viktor Nešić
intro.offer: Viktor Nešić is a senior mobile developer building native iOS, Android and Kotlin Multiplatform apps with Swift, SwiftUI, UIKit, Kotlin and Jetpack Compose. Available for freelance and contract projects, working remotely.

items: Built the Android app in Java on Firebase.
Built onboarding with photo, gender, interest and city.
Built city group chats, friends and the profile.
